marketing_wrapper: All six use a warm near-black #110e09 backdrop with a centred white caption and subcaption in the top ~40%, then a realistic black iPhone frame cropped at the bottom showing ~45% of the image as UI. 02 and 05 show in-app Gold promo screens (still real UI, but promotional).

typography.display: Captions and in-app headings: custom neutral grotesk at regular weight (consistent with the single-sourced 'Robinhood Phonic', unsure). Gold surfaces: a high-contrast classical serif for 'Earn 3.6% APY' and '3% IRA Match' (consistent with Martina Plantijn)
typography.weights: Strikingly light: balances and headings in regular, not bold; semibold only on change figures and chips
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; range labels in caps (1D, YTD, ALL, LIVE); normal tracking

accents: #ccff00 (visual estimate of Robin Neon; palette.json 05 #889b37 is an anti-aliased blend)
palette.accent_strategy: One owned accent: Robin Neon carries the chart line, change figure, range selector and IRA promo. Gold gradient reserved for the Gold tier. Purple appears only as a data colour in prediction markets.
palette.source: palette.json 01-06 (#110e09 ~43% backdrop, #000000 24-43% in-app canvas), 03 (#19191b card surface 16%); neon and purple visual

shape.radius_language: mixed: cards ~16pt with hairline border; filter chips full pills with outline; primary buttons full pills; selected range chip small rounded rect ~6pt
shape.borders_shadows: Hairline grey borders on cards and chips; no shadows
shape.materials: flat; 3D render used as list-header art (24 Hour Market)

density: low on portfolio/crypto (one number and one chart fill the screen); medium on prediction markets (chip rows, horizontal card carousel)
layout: Portfolio and crypto: label + value stacked top-left, full-width line chart, range selector row; nothing else above the fold. Prediction markets: nav bar with back and settings, horizontally scrolling outline chips, carousel cards with three probability bars and a white Trade pill.
navigation: Standard back chevron and title nav bar; no tab bar visible in any crop
imagery_and_icons: Line SF-Symbol-like outline icons in chips; 3D extruded '24' in blue-to-neon gradient as collection art; no photography in UI
signature_visual_move: A single thin Robin Neon line chart on pure black, with the balance set in regular weight rather than bold.
tells_present: Gradient backgrounds and gradient text (gold gradient '3.6%' and gold gradient Join Gold pill on the Gold upsell)

direction_fit.why: Text record tagged Calm Modular (widget Dashboard) plus Private-Bank Editorial. The screens show a chart-as-hero dark interface with a light-weight face and one bright data colour, which matches Cinematic Dark Data except that the canvas is pure #000. The serif appears only on Gold promotion screens, confirming Private-Bank Editorial as a premium-tier secondary. No widget Dashboard is shown.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Balance: white regular weight (not bold) ~1.8x body, label ('Investing', 'Crypto') set at the same size and weight directly above it, top-left. Cents same size; $ full size; no space. Tabular: unsure. Change line: '▲ $0.2800 (26.47%) Today' with filled triangle, figure in neon semibold, 'Today' in white. No negative amount shown, so the down colour is unverified. Chart: thin (~1.5pt) jagged neon line edge to edge, no fill, no axes, a dotted horizontal reference line (previous close), a glowing end-point dot on the live chart. Range selector: neon text labels, selected one in a filled neon rounded rectangle with black text; 'LIVE' with a dot prefix. Prediction markets use purple bars with % labels above and thresholds below. Gold upsell: serif hero numerals with gold gradient fill, gold gradient pill CTA. No amount entry or order confirm shown.
